nom: Caudalie Vinoperfect Brightening Dark Spot Niacinamide Moisturizer - 50 mL

avis.titre: The jar of the cream.was not full.
avis.texte: I do love this cream. However the last jar I received had an empty space that went down to the bottom of the jar.. Now this cream is expensive,I don’t mind paying for a full jar, I do mind paying for empty space.. I kind of feel cheated.. I’ll looking for another brand—such as PEVONIA, which I used for many years, and never had that experience with the product..

avis.titre: Absorbs quickly, not greasy, a little goes a long way
avis.texte: Same price as department stores. I’ve only used a couple of times, but I already love it. It may seem pricey, but a little bit goes such a long way. I am able to put a dot on each cheek, my forehead, and chin and it is enough to cover my face and neck. The scent is great and my skin feels so soft after applying. It also absorbs very quickly and doesn’t leave a greasy feel. I have sensitive skin and have had no issues with this moisturizer.
Good moisturizer it help me to get rid of my dark spots .. It works amazing with Caudalie serum.

Okay… So I’ve tried every single suggestion I’ve ever gotten for dealing with my breakouts… nothing worked. I did some research on this product and decided to give it a try. Bought this and the vinoperfect serum and let me tell you… This stuff is AMAZING! It does have a stein fragrance but when I get a pimple, the next day is dry and almost done! I do use this every night and even my husband, when he touches my face, keeps telling me how soft it is! It not greasy, and it wears beautifully under makeup. Give it a try!!

avis.titre: Caudalie Vinoperfect Instant Brightening & Dark Spot remover
avis.texte: It works beautifully, and it leaves my skin feeling soft, moisturized and brighter over time with fewer visible lines👌🏽! Awesome 👏🏽
Bought this because of my skin appearance especially under my eyes. This did not help and the texture it leaves on your skin is sticky.
Perfect size that fits in my original container. I use this Claudine vinoperfect before I put my foundation on.

Ich habe im GASICHT Altersflecke und deswegen habe ich diese Creme gekauft, benutze ich sie seit einiger Zeit und bin der Meinung - die Flecke sind etwas hellet geworden! Alles braucht Zeit und wenn die Flecke noch heller werden können, das ist doch wunderbaar.
Excelente producto, deja mi piel super hidratada y las manchas disminuyeron y no se han vuelo a oscurecer
O produto em si é maravilhoso e a entrega foi super rápida, chegou antes de prazo e veio bem embalado

avis.titre: Feel silky—and they plant trees! Love.
avis.texte: This Vinoperfect moisturizer feels amazingly smooth. It almost feels like a serum going over my skin—that silky quality that serum has. I only need a very small amount, which makes the cost of this not so bad as a little goes a long way. I like to look at the cost of a product with how much I need to use and how long it will last versus maybe a cheaper product where I need more. This Vinoperfect is so emollient, just a little works perfectly, and in fact, if I put too much, my skin feels too ‘oily’ and heavy—using a just a bit has it absorb nicely into my skin to leave it really soft and supple. The scent is very light; I can hardly detect it. It’s not too floral. Just a nice light scent. I LOVE that they give back to the planting of trees—this is a passion of mine (tree protection) so that right there gets my five stars and my interest in their other products. Though I don’t have dark spots on my face, I do have aging skin, and a little brightening helps that dull look aging skin can have. Though it will take time to see any results whether big or small, the product is lovely and feels lovely and gives my skin an immediate glow. Recommend. Thank you for reading my review.

avis.titre: Caudalie, world brand that I trust!
avis.texte: I know this brand well, bought it many times before in duty free whole globe hopping, and it never disappoints, including this cream. Let’s starts that it smells like a million dollars, you can tell just by the smell that it’s expensive, high quality cream made in France. Caudalie proudly been on the market for as long as I remember so I always trust it. This cream also medium light, just what I like. It does help to get rid of spots with regular use & of course continues skin care routine. It is definitely brand and product I would recommend to my friends and family without hesitation!

Item came damaged. It was leaking inside the box and around the glass bottle. Also Caudalie products usually have barrier once you open the product lid. This didn’t have it. Item looks like it was used and returned by someone else.

Caudalie products are of a high caliber in my experience and this Vinoperfect instant brightening moisturizer is no exception. I have been using this in conjuction with the purifying gel cleanser. This moisturizer is silky and smooth with a pleasant fragrance that's not overpowering. The scent lingers slightly on the skin. My face, neck and decollete area just love this product. I apply liberally and my skin drinks it up. I use it morning and night, after cleansing, toner, and a good serum. This moisturizer works well with the other products and does not cause an adverse reaction. In the morning when I wake up, my face looks hydrated and supple, as though I've had eight-plus hours of uninterrupted sleep - even when I haven't.
